These fixtures are inert function definitions for static analysis. Run `python3 testdata/triage-renpy-loader/check.py`; do not execute the fixture functions.

The positive fixture combines independently observable source behaviors. Its two suspicious composites report co-occurrence, without claiming that the file-handle or payload-byte relationship has been proven. Near misses remove command execution, obfuscation, write mode, or the local-zone value. The local-expression controls retain notable eval reporting while rejecting remote-code/backdoor conclusions based solely on a variable name or HTTP-library co-occurrence.

The motivating archive stores its loader inside an RPA/RPYC container that the current engine does not unpack. These source fixtures test recovered-code detection and do not claim original-archive coverage. Original-container detection needs engine extraction support; archive names, sizes and sandbox scores cannot replace that evidence.
